title: Tighten the TS-37 and TS-35 corrupt-state-file proofs: the Stage 1 MINOR and NITs
description:
Follow-up from the Stage 1 verdicts on opum-ai/test-skills#55 (TS-37) and #56 (TS-35), each recorded verbatim on its completed record. To Do, off the plan.

From TS-37: (2) MINOR, tests/test_gate.py helper _assert_corrupt_head_is_named_with_a_base asserts the rule but never the ARTICLE (XI quarantine, XII probation), so swapping them survives that helper; assert res violations[0] article. (1) NIT, the check that kind appears in the message can never fail because the path already contains it; assert the phrase "is the quarantine state file" or "is the probation state file" instead. (3) NIT, in the both-copies-corrupt arm the base is read as empty rests on the info line presence, not its "newly added" clause. (4) NIT, evidence only: the cited mutant (making _load_base_list re-raise) was already killed by older assertions; a discriminating mutant skips the base load when the head load raised, which only the helper corrupt-base arm catches.

From TS-35: (2) NIT, write_baseline still aborts at the first StateFileError so it names one corrupt file; add a code comment or load each file separately. (3) NIT, tests/test_gate_matrix.py write_baseline assertion depends on probation being read first; assert on either file or pin the order on purpose. (4) NIT, a TS-35 acceptance criterion about out-of-scope findings cannot be satisfied or falsified by code; process note only. (5) Note, the sub-root nested repo in the probation test must stay after the last parent _commit.

Fold into existing cases; no new collected case beyond the 95 cap.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The corrupt-head helper asserts the article by kind and a kind token that is not part of the path.
The both-copies-corrupt arm asserts the newly added clause, or the weaker form is recorded with a reason.
The TS-35 test-side NITs 2 and 3 are addressed or recorded as accepted; no collected case is added beyond 95.
